word_rank_definition: Human trigger_relevance norming ranks versus descending summed neutral continuation log probabilities, over six tested words per context; not cloze frequency correlations.
selection: Word Spearman equals 1 within absolute roundoff tolerance 1e-12; exact equality of six human/model rank vectors verified.
evaluation: Pearson and average-tie Spearman of model exclusion probabilities against observed item rates. Equal item weights; arithmetic mean of per-context correlations. Pooled Spearman reranks all 60 items together.
predictions: Original corrected held-out predictions retained; no boundary selection or refit on the selected subset. Identical Ordering variants deduplicated.
limitations: Two contexts only. Descriptive selected-subset analysis, not an equivalence/significance test or evidence that human/model probabilities or full distributions agree.
